combos.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Scholar of the Ages and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Scholar of the Ages and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Resolve the Scholar of the Ages trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Repeat.

combos.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Sefris' first ability triggers, causing you to venture into the final room of a dungeon, causing you to complete the dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers. Holding priority, activate Phantom Train twice by sacrificing Sefris and Sun Titan.
Resolve the Sefris trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver and into the Cave Entrace room, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver and into either available room.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Sefris from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sefris enters, Radiant Solar triggers, venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver and into any available room.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 1.
Repeat.
combos.easyPrerequisites: Sefris' first ability hasn't triggered this turn.
combos.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in the second to last room of any dungeon.

combos.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Tomb of Horrors Adventurer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Tomb of Horrors Adventurer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Tomb of Horrors Adventurer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Tomb of Horrors Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Tomb of Horrors Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Tomb of Horrors Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Tomb of Horrors Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Tomb of Horrors Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
combos.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.

Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by The Earth Crystal.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by The Earth Crystal.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 10 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

combos.description:
Activate Zul Ashur by tapping it, targeting a Zombie card in your graveyard.
Activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding enough mana to cast the Zombie.
Cast the Zombie from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the Zombie, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train.
Repeat.
combos.notablePrerequisites:
You have a Zombie creature card in your graveyard.
Creatures you control can tap to produce enough mana to cast the Zombie in your graveyard.
Zul Ashur does not have summoning sickness.

combos.description:
Declare Tetsuo as an attacker. Tetsuo triggers, causing you to cast Savage Beating without paying its mana cost, choosing its second mode.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, copying Savage Beating.
Resolve both Savage Beatings, causing you to get two additional combat phases after this one.
Move to your first combat phase.
Declare Tetsuo as an attacker. Tetsuo triggers, causing you to cast Said // Done without paying its mana cost, targeting Sorceress's Schemes.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, copying Said // Done, targeting Savage Beating.
Resolve both Said // Dones, causing you to return Sorceress's Schemes and Savage Beating from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your second combat phase.
Repeat steps 1 through 4 one additional time.
Declare Tetsuo as an attacker. Tetsuo triggers, causing you to cast Sorceress's Schemes without paying its mana cost, targeting Said // Done.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, copying Sorceress's Schemes, targeting Savage Beating.
Resolve both Sorceress's Schemess, causing you to return Said // Done and Savage Beating from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your second combat phase, and repeat from step 1.
combos.notablePrerequisites:
Tetsuo has an Equipment attached to it with mana value 5 or greater.
Tetsuo does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Said // Done or Sorceress's Schemes must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.

combos.description:

combos.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
When Ebondeath enters, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Ebondeath and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Ebondeath dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
combos.notablePrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.

produces: Infinitely powerful Bird tokens you control until end of turn
combos.description:
Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning one of the lands from the battlefield to your hand, untapping the other land.
Play the land returned to your hand in step 2.
When the land enters the battlefield, Kodama and Chocobo Racetrack trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Chocobo Racetrack trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers.
Holding priority, activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning one of the lands from the battlefield to your hand, untapping the other land.
Resolve the Kodama trigger from step 7, putting the land returned to your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Chocobo Racetrack triggers, creating a token.
Repeat from step 7.
combos.notablePrerequisites:
You are able to play a land this turn.

produces: Infinite copies of all tokens you control
combos.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Mondrak and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Put either Mondrak token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Ratadrabik triggers four times from the nontoken and token Mondraks dying.
Resolve the first trigger, creating 2^X nonlegendary token copies of Mondrak that are 2/2 Zombies, where X is the number of Mondraks you control.
Repeat step 4 for the remaining triggers.

produces: Infinite copies of all tokens you control

combos.description:
Cast Maelstrom Wanderer by paying {5}{G}{U}{R}, plus commander tax if applicable.
This triggers both of Maelstrom Wanderer's cascade abilities and both of Momir Vig's abilities.
Resolve Momir Vig's first ability, search your library for Avenger of Zendikar and putting it on top of your library.
Resolve one of Maelstrom Wanderer's cascade abilities, exiling Avenger of Zendikar from your library and casting it without paying its mana cost.
Momir Vig's first ability triggers again, causing you to search your library for Thicket Elemental and put it on top of your library.
Avenger of Zendikar enters the battlefield, triggering itself, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token for each land you control.
Resolve the remaining cascade trigger, exiling Thicket Elemental from your library and casting it without paying its mana cost, choosing to pay an additional {1}{G} for its kicker cost.
Momir Vig's first ability triggers again, causing you to search your library for Craterhoof Behemoth and put it on top of your library.
Thicket Elemental enters the battlefield, triggering itself, revealing Craterhoof Behemoth and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Craterhoof Behemoth enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, giving creatures you control trample and +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of creatures you control.
Resolve Momir Vig's final trigger from step 2, revealing the top card of your library and putting it into your hand if it is a creature card.
Maelstrom Wanderer enters the battlefield.
You may attack with all of your creatures since they are granted haste by Maelstrom Wanderer.
